screen.title: Sky Strata layers
layer.kind.tooltip: Continents: huge landmasses with cliffs. Islands: frequent big islands. Shards: small scattered rocks.
layer.gap.tooltip: Blocks between the top of the previous layer (sea level for the first one) and the bottom of this layer.
layer.thickness.tooltip: Vertical size of the layer in blocks.
layer.density.tooltip: How much of the sky the layer covers.
preset.classic.tooltip: The original layout: giant continents, a dense island layer and scattered shards.
preset.archipelago.tooltip: No continents: two island layers with shards above them.
preset.tower.tooltip: Five layers stacked high: continents, two island layers and two shard layers.
preset.giants.tooltip: A single layer of huge continents with wide gaps.
preset.shattered.tooltip: Only small rocks: three sparse shard layers.
info.too_tall: Layers are too high: the world ends at y %s
